description: React component implementing an advanced date range picker with preset relative times, custom date inputs, validation, and dropdown UI.

methods.name: AdvancedDatePicker
methods.description: React functional component for selecting date ranges with presets and custom input.

methods.name: getMatchingOption
methods.description: Determines if the current value matches any of the predefined relative time options.

methods.name: validateDateRange
methods.description: Validates the custom date inputs ensuring correctness and logical order.

methods.name: formatDisplayRange
methods.description: Formats the currently selected date range for display.

methods.name: adjustDateRange
methods.description: Standardizes the date range to start/end of day, considering same-day logic.

methods.name: handleRelativeTimeSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a relative time option, updating the temporary value and UI.

methods.name: updateTempValueFromInputs
methods.description: Updates temporary date range state based on manual date inputs and validation.

methods.name: handleApply
methods.description: Confirms current selections, applies adjustments, and closes the dropdown.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Reverts changes and closes the dropdown without applying.
